_doc: Per-m2 seasonal figures. engine/build.py spreads them over season_days and multiplies by props.area_m2. 1 mm of water on 1 m2 = 1 L. trust as in animals.json.

tomato.season_source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 66 (2012), tomato: life cycle 95-115 days (processing) to over 145 days (fresh market); 120 used

rates.source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 66 (2012), tomato: 400-800 mm from transplanting to harvest, by climate and management
FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 66 (2012), tomato: good commercial yield 60-120 t/ha (processing), over 150 t/ha fresh market

lettuce.season_source: UC Cooperative Extension Imperial County (2000): iceberg matures in under 90 to 120+ days; Arizona Extension AZ2144 (2025): season to 89 days after planting

rates.source: Arizona Extension AZ2144 (2025), Yuma: lettuce needs about 12-16 inches of water per acre (Sanchez et al. 2022)
UC Cooperative Extension Imperial County (2000): naked pack iceberg 453-645 cartons/acre of 50 lb, 1995-1999
